note: The Isoptera volume of Fauna Sinica gives the species-level account under the name Mironasutitermes tianmuensis Gao et He, 1988, covering major and minor soldiers and major and minor workers; the name, the type locality (Tianmu Shan, Zhejiang) and the naming authors being identical, the entry is compiled from it, noting the combination difference.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: The soldier is dimorphic. Major soldier: head brown, nasus reddish brown, antennae yellowish brown, anterior lobe of the pronotum pale reddish brown, meso- and metathorax and abdominal tergites yellowish brown, legs pale yellow. Head with very few hairs, the tip of the nasus with a few short hairs. Head broadly circular, the antennal fossae extending backwards, widest in the middle, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave; in lateral view the posterior part of the dorsal margin of the head strongly elevated, the middle lower. Nasus upturned, slightly elevated at the base, rather long and cylindrical, the mandibular teeth distinct. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 the longest, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 4. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior lobe slightly shorter than the posterior lobe, the middle of the anterior and posterior margins without a notch. Minor soldier: head paler, pilosity as in the major soldier; head almost circular, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave, in lateral view the posterior part of the dorsal margin of the head elevated and the middle lower; nasus upturned, slightly elevated at the base, cylindrical and rather long, the mandibular teeth indistinct; antennae 13-segmented, segments 2 and 4 about equal, segment 3 far longer than segment 2. Measurements (mm, range/mean for the major soldier; range/mean for the minor soldier): head length including nasus 1.85—1.94/1.90 and 1.70—1.80/1.75; head length without nasus 1.01—1.05/1.03 and 0.85—0.91/0.89; head width 1.05—1.11/1.08 and 0.93—0.98/0.95; head height (with genae) 0.85—0.91/0.89 and 0.75—0.89/0.76; pronotum width 0.55—0.64/0.60 and 0.48—0.51/0.50; hind tibia length 1.15—1.31/1.25 and 0.96—1.12/1.04.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Major worker: head yellowish brown, the pale T-shaped suture visible, antennae pale yellowish brown, meso- and metathorax and abdominal tergites pale yellowish brown, legs pale yellow. Head almost circular with the sides slightly straight, widest near the antennal fossae and gradually narrowing backwards, the posterior margin broadly arcuate; postclypeus convex, about 3 times as wide as long; posterior margin of the apical tooth of the left mandible about equal to the anterior margin of the first marginal tooth, the posterior margin of the first marginal tooth of the right mandible slightly longer than that of the apical tooth and shorter than that of the second marginal tooth. Head length to the tip of the clypeus 1.26—1.35 (1.32) mm, head width 1.10—1.12 (1.11) mm, the median notch of the anterior margin of the pronotum distinct, width 0.62—0.64 (0.63) mm. Minor worker: head paler than in the major worker, head shape as in the major worker, the T-shaped suture indistinct; head length to the tip of the clypeus 1.15—1.21 (1.18) mm, head width 0.97—0.99 (0.98) mm, pronotum width 0.54—0.55 (0.545) mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Distribution: Tianmu Shan, Zhejiang. Fauna Sinica places it in the genus Mironasutitermes as Mironasutitermes tianmuensis Gao et He, 1988 (Contr. Shanghai Inst. Entom. 8: 179—188); this list retains the original combination Nasutitermes tianmuensis Gao, 1988.
